label: تقرير

gfx.label: نسخ مباعة منذ إطلاقها في 30 أكتوبر

angle.hook: a retro dungeon RPG made by two people has passed 200,000 copies in two weeks
angle.why_now: the publisher posted the 200,000 figure on X on 14 November, ten days after the studio's own Steam post marked 100,000 copies in five days
angle.what_it_means_here: Gulf PC players can buy it on the Steam store for the UAE at AED 67.99 and the game also runs on PS5, Xbox Series X|S and Switch 2, but Steam lists no Arabic language and the figure itself is the publisher's claim relayed by Game*Spark
angle.payoff: the 200 thousand card with the 100 thousand in five days beneath it, then the two-person team and the platform list

reel_check.SOURCE: primary read in full: partly: the publisher's X post could not be read; Game*Spark read in full (14 Nov 08:27Z), Steam 100k announcement and Steam store API read; label تقرير
reel_check.SOURCE: not already posted: yes: ledger find by hand, one hit (launch story of 31 Oct), the 200,000 figure is new
reel_check.SOURCE: age: yes: first report 14 Nov 08:27Z, under 24 hours
reel_check.ANGLE before lines: yes: angle in the story file and job
reel_check.STORY TYPE numbers: yes: figure 200 thousand, period two weeks, source the publisher via Game*Spark, comparison 100 thousand in five days (Steam post)
reel_check.STORY: spoken paragraph, subject before: yes: headline names the game, line 1 names the publisher, line 2 starts with the verb on the game as subject
reel_check.STORY: release verbs: yes: no release verb on screen; the caption says its release date as «إطلاقها في 30 أكتوبر»
reel_check.STORY: names match names-ar.md: yes: فيوتشر فريندز غيمز (Future Friends Games) with the bracket in the credit and غيم سبارك, as in the names-ar rows
reel_check.POST: Arabic passes: yes: both skills applied, grammar review stage run, Western digits, no first person, DeepL forward pass whole story
reel_check.SOUND: footage sound or bed with reason: yes: our bed with the reason in bed_reason (RDA split measured effects-led; Launch split not run); the director signs it off; the preview says our bed
reel_check.SOUND: no speech under Arabic lines: yes: faster-whisper small, VAD on and off, no speech in the Launch and RDA trailers (VAD off: one hallucinated word near the end, no speech)
reel_check.PICTURE: footage first: yes: official Steam trailer RDA; every window judged at 2 fps as 9:16 crops at full size after the director FAIL; no blood, spatter, weapons or skeletons
reel_check.PICTURE: not the same as last 5 reels: yes: no earlier Reel uses Queen's Domain footage (the 31 Oct launch Reel is 15 days old)
reel_check.CREDIT: on every clip: yes: المصدر: فيوتشر فريندز غيمز (Future Friends Games) over shots 0 to 4 and 6 to 7

bed_reason: Steam trailers opened: RDA (the footage's trailer) and Launch (opened for picture and audio, not used: first-person weapons in its clean stretches; its audio split was not run). RDA audio split rendered on the server 14 Nov 14:47Z: music 35.2% of the stretch with 42.8% leftover effects (effects-led, under the 40% floor), and the shots come from different moments (4.6 to 55.4 s), so one continuous stretch cannot sit under them and trailer effects from other moments would not match the picture; our bed
